scope: Local merge, integrity verification, report reconciliation, and bounds review of the split PROSTATEx outer-fold 4 retrieval bundle; no local DICOM decoding or clinical review

patient_exclusion.reason: T2 axial and ADC FrameOfReferenceUID values differ

finding_exclusion.reason: The complete grid lies before the first ADC pixel-center plane. This is a genuine bounds failure under the frozen no-padding/no-clipping pixel-center rule, not floating-point noise.

conclusion: Fold 4 retrieval completed with one patient exclusion and one additional finding-level exclusion. All 80 series passed series geometry; 61 findings were accepted, two findings were removed with ProstateX-0202, and ProstateX-0189 finding 3 was removed for a genuine ADC bounds failure.
limitations: The archived report retains its original REVIEW_REQUIRED status; the effective status is a documented post-review resolution.
This local reconciliation verifies bundle bytes and recorded geometry but does not repeat pydicom decoding locally.
The result does not establish anatomical registration, image quality, ADC physical units, label correctness, or clinical validity.
next_step: Freeze the final post-download eligible cohort across all five outer folds before patch extraction.
